verdict.rationale: Pika documents Swap Anything for replacing characters, outfits, backgrounds or props in a video, and a masked edit flow ('paint the area to change, describe your edit'). Add Elements and Pikadditions cover inserting or erasing items in a shot, together delivering targeted element replacement in existing clips. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the rest of the frame is preserved unchanged (only implied by the masking), in-depth documentation of video-specific restyling beyond one-line descriptions, independent or hands-on corroboration of edit quality.
